citations.narrative:
During inspection, APHIS Officials found the following non-compliances:
A broken tile with sharp edges by the drain in front of the dog kennels where dog paws can get entrapped and injured.
The floor of areas that come in contact with dogs and cats must be impervious to moisture to clean and sanitized properly.
Peeling paint on the walls behind the kennels. The ceiling and walls of areas used by dogs and cats must be impervious
to moisture or be replaceable.
The floors and walls of indoor housing facilities, and any other surfaces in contact with the animals, must be impervious to
moisture. The ceilings of indoor housing facilities must be impervious to moisture or be replaceable (e.g., a suspended
ceiling with replaceable panels).
To be corrected by November 1, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with Attending Veterinarian.
Additional Inspectors:
Lemnique Wafer, Assistant Director n
